tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search AgentShopping offers. Optional filters cover typed product attrs (eu_size, size_cm, age_months, head_cm, total_nok_max, and the rest of the schema). q also parses phrases such as 'str 33', 'til 3-åring', 'under 5000 kr' and '52 cm hode'. If sample_data is true, prices are fictional. Ranking n

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by slug, gtin or id with its ranked offers: clean title, brand, category, gtin, size, and per offer price_incl_shipping, in_stock and verified_checkout_url. detail=full adds price history. Sample rows are labelled sample=true.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List stores in the merchant directory, compact: categories they sell, markets, currencies, live offer count, price band incl. shipping, affiliate network and the store page. Paged: limit (default 5, maximum 50) and cursor. sample=true means the store is seeded example data, not a live feed.

tools.name: find_stores_for
tools.description: Find which stores sell a category, optionally in one country. Returns the same compact store records as list_merchants (price band incl. shipping, live offer count, networks, store page). Use search_offers for products and /go/ shop links. Sample rows must not be cited as live prices.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
